# Formsite

Formsite helps users create online forms and surveys with drag-and-drop tools, secure data capture, and integrations to simplify workflows

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/formsite/.

## Actions

- **Get Form Items** (read-only): This tool retrieves all items (questions) for a specific form using the get https.
- **Get Form Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific form in formsite.
- **Get Form Results** (read-only): This tool retrieves the latest form results from a specified formsite form.
- **Get Form Webhooks** (read-only): This tool retrieves all webhooks configured for a specific form in formsite.
- **List All Forms** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all forms in the user's formsite account.
